name: Stablecoin ETH-share rotation -> ETH demand nowcast (long ETH, share momentum)
rationale: ECONOMIC MECHANISM: stablecoin_eth_share rising means stablecoin supply is migrating onto Ethereum rails specifically (2025: stablecoins ~30% of on-chain volume, growth toward $500B cited as the main ETH-activity driver). When dry powder concentrates on ETH rather than Tron/Solana, it is a directional bet that deployment (DeFi, spot) will happen on ETH — a rotation nowcast that can lead ETH demand. The counterparty is cross-chain arbitrageurs and issuers rebalancing mint venues; the edge is that share shifts reflect where end-demand is forming before it prices in. Entry: stablecoin_eth_share rising above a fitted momentum floor AND aggregate stablecoin_mcap not contracting (so the rotation is into a growing, not shrinking, pool). Long ETH; exit on share rolling over or stop/TP/time. DISCONFIRMER 1: share moves can be driven by a single large mint-venue switch (issuer mechanics), not end-demand -> KILL if the signal is dominated by one discrete jump. DISCONFIRMER 2: KILL if eth_share is coincident with ETH price (no lead) after BH-FDR. DISCONFIRMER 3: data-availability — eth_share history may be short/revised; verify PIT coverage. Net of fees, DSR>=0.95.
catalyst: stablecoin supply rotating onto ETH rails ahead of deployment
